## Valhalla Shield Plans (Mandatory Standards)

- Poetry must be used for project and dependency management (pyproject.toml is required)
- A `.env.example` file must be provided and kept up to date for all environment variables
- All configuration and environment variable management must use Pydantic's `BaseSettings` throughout the ecosystem











- Work through each checklist item systematically.
- Keep communication concise and focused.
- Follow development best practices.
